# Core Summary
An epic fantasy action sequence set on a frozen grassland under pale orange dawn, featuring a girl rider <ID_A> on horseback <ID_C> hunting a six-limbed ice predator <ID_B>. The clip follows a high-velocity short arc: the beast charges, the rider harpoons it, maneuvers to create tension, and dismounts to anchor the creature, ending in a stillness warmed by sunrise. The structure uses a 3-shot progression to maximize pacing within 15 seconds: [shot1] establishes the charge and harpoon throw at horse level; [shot2] cuts to a wide side sweep showing the rope tension and turning maneuver; [shot3] transitions to an overhead arc for the dismount, takedown, and resolution.

# Scene
[shot1][00:00-00:05] Frozen grassland stretching to a flat horizon, ice crystals glittering on the ground. Pale orange dawn light floods from the left, casting long blue shadows to the right. Air is filled with suspended ice dust and breath plumes.
[shot2][00:05-00:10] Same frozen plain, camera angle shifts to side profile. Snow trails mark curved paths on the ice surface. Lighting remains consistent with low-angle dawn sun creating rim light on moving subjects.
[shot3][00:10-00:15] High-angle overhead view transitioning to eye-level. A dark stone boulder sits in the foreground. The background horizon glows brighter as the sun rises slightly. Ice shards scatter across the ground.

# Subjects Description
<ID_A>: Female, young adult, East Asian. Wears layered wool armor in earthy browns and greys, carved antler shoulder plates. Hair tied back tightly. Athletic build.
<ID_B>: Non-human ice predator. Long neck, translucent blue fins along the spine, six running limbs with clawed tips. Skin resembles cracked glacial ice.
<ID_C>: Horse, sturdy build, dark coat with winter fur. Equipped with leather riding gear.

# Dynamic Narrative
[shot1][00:00-00:05] Low-angle tracking shot at horse level. <ID_C> gallops hard from left to right across the frame. <ID_A> leans forward in the saddle, facing right. <ID_B> charges in from the right background, moving left toward the horse. <ID_A> swings a rope harpoon overhead and throws it forward. The harpoon strikes <ID_B>'s shoulder fin. Snow sprays up from <ID_C>'s hooves. Camera shakes slightly with the gallop rhythm.

[shot2][00:05-00:10] Wide side sweep cut. <ID_C> banks hard to the left, pulling the rope taut. <ID_B> is dragged off its running line, six limbs scrambling for traction on the ice. The rope vibrates with tension between them. <ID_A> holds the rope firmly, body leaning opposite to the pull. Camera accelerates, moving from side view to a front lead angle, showing <ID_B>'s face straining against the tether. Breath plumes from both animals collide in the cold air.

[shot3][00:10-00:15] Overhead arc transitioning to ground level. <ID_A> leaps from <ID_C> onto a foreground boulder, anchoring the rope around a stone spike. <ID_B>'s momentum carries it forward into a slide, claws carving deep grooves in the ice until it halts. <ID_C> slows to a walk nearby. <ID_A> cuts the rope loose. <ID_B> lies still. Dawn light intensifies, warming the blue ice to orange. Camera pulls back slowly to a wide static shot.

# Style, Color & Aesthetics
Cinematic fantasy action style with high contrast and sharp focus. Color palette dominated by cold glacial blues and whites, contrasted with warm pale orange dawn light. Textures emphasize fur, ice, wool, and stone. Lighting uses strong rim lighting to separate subjects from the background. Motion blur is minimal to keep action crisp. High dynamic range to capture both shadow detail in the ice and highlight detail in the sunrise.

# Atmosphere & Emotion
Tense, thrilling, and majestic. The atmosphere conveys the harshness of the frozen environment and the intensity of the hunt. Emotional progression moves from high-adrenaline anticipation to a satisfying, calm resolution. The sound of wind, galloping, and sliding ice should feel immersive and cold.
